description: This file contains extension methods for the IStreamSubscriptionManager interface in Orleans for managing stream subscriptions, providing helper methods to add subscriptions for grains of various key types and a method to retrieve the subscription manager from a stream provider.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionManagerExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IStreamSubscriptionManager to facilitate adding stream subscriptions for grains with various key types and retrieving subscription managers.

methods.name: AddSubscription<TGrainInterface>(this IStreamSubscriptionManager, IGrainFactory, StreamId, string, GrainId)
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain identified by GrainId (Guid key) to a stream.

methods.name: AddSubscription<TGrainInterface>(this IStreamSubscriptionManager, IGrainFactory, StreamId, string, Guid, string)
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain with a Guid primary key and optional class prefix to a stream.

methods.name: AddSubscription<TGrainInterface>(this IStreamSubscriptionManager, IGrainFactory, StreamId, string, long, string)
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain with a long primary key and optional class prefix to a stream.

methods.name: AddSubscription<TGrainInterface>(this IStreamSubscriptionManager, IGrainFactory, StreamId, string, string, string)
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain with a string primary key and optional class prefix to a stream.

methods.name: AddSubscription<TGrainInterface>(this IStreamSubscriptionManager, IGrainFactory, StreamId, string, Guid, string, string)
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain with a Guid compound key and optional class prefix to a stream.

methods.name: AddSubscription<TGrainInterface>(this IStreamSubscriptionManager, IGrainFactory, StreamId, string, long, string, string)
methods.description: Adds a subscription for a grain with a long compound key and optional class prefix to a stream.

methods.name: TryGetStreamSubscriptionManager(this IStreamProvider, out IStreamSubscriptionManager)
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the IStreamSubscriptionManager from a stream provider.
